# Cars

## Row {height=50%}

### Column {width=50%}

::: {.card title="Mileage by displacement"}

```{r}
#| label: vis-mpg-by-disp
ggplot(data = mtcars, aes(x = disp, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()
```

:::

### Column {width=50%}

::: {.card title="Mileage by horsepower"}

```{r}
ggplot(data = mtcars, aes(x = hp, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_minimal()
```

:::
